answer: Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 6 epochs, which means holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in voyage and lotus lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the mesa graph. Verification costs 6 dollars and 4 days per identity, which turns a 4253 account sybil into a 4 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
